payload._note: ABR is a commercial real estate finance/mortgage REIT that originates and invests in loans secured by multifamily and commercial properties. The business model is structured finance (bridge loans, mezzanine, preferred equity) and agency loan origination/servicing, not property ownership with named tenants. The 10-K provides extensive detail on loan portfolio composition by asset class (88% multifamily, 10% single-family rental, etc.) and geography, but does not disclose individual borrower/tenant names or rent concentrations in the traditional sense. No tenant exposure table is present or applicable to this REIT's business model.
